issue_context.title: Ps4 Error during media_player async_setup_platform : AttributeError: 'collections.OrderedDict' object has no attribute 'data'
issue_context.body:
**Home Assistant release with the issue:**
0.96

**Last working Home Assistant release (if known):**
Unknown

**Operating environment (Hass.io/Docker/Windows/etc.):**
Hass.io

**Component/platform:**
[ps4](https://www.home-assistant.io/components/ps4/)


**Description of problem:**
An error is raised during the setup of ps4 media_player.
Line     creds = config.data[CONF_TOKEN]
AttributeError: 'collections.OrderedDict' object has no attribute 'data'

**Traceback (if applicable):**
```
Error while setting up platform ps4
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/entity_platform.py", line 146, in _async_setup_platform
    await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.shield(task), SLOW_SETUP_MAX_WAIT)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/asyncio/tasks.py", line 442, in wait_for
    return fut.result()
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/ps4/media_player.py", line 66, in async_setup_platform
    creds = config.data[CONF_TOKEN]
AttributeError: 'collections.OrderedDict' object has no attribute 'data'
```

**Additional information:**
comments:
Hey there @ktnrg45, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with a integration (`ps4`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L208) for? Thanks!

_This is a automatic comment generated by [codeowners-mention](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant) to help ensure issues and pull requests are seen by the right people._
Hello. It seems that there is an issue with the integration setup. Try removing the ps4 integration and retry the setup again.
We shouldn't reuse `async_setup_platform` and call it in `async_setup_entry` like we currently do. We should move the logic to `async_setup_entry`.

> We shouldn't reuse `async_setup_platform` and call it in `async_setup_entry` like we currently do. We should move the logic to `async_setup_entry`.

Agreed. Duplicated by adding to configuration.yaml:

```
media_player:
  - platform: ps4
```

@FreeTHX The PS4 integration requires a specific setup. The integration is not added via configuration.yaml, which seems to be the cause of the error, but rather navigating on your frontend to configuration -> integrations. To get rid of the error you will have to remove the ps4 platform from your configuration.yaml

You can get more info from the docs at https://www.home-assistant.io/components/ps4/

review_comments:
Maybe add a notification or handle/raise a specific exception if async_setup_platform is called? Still would get a error.

`AttributeError: module 'homeassistant.components.ps4.media_player' has no attribute 'setup_platform'`
We usually implement it but just `pass`.
